VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2023
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  Victor Hill, Commissioner
Ryan Antes, Commissioner  Mike Shaknovich, Commissioner
Sylvia Contreras, Commissioner  Josh Smith, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Acting Chair, Ryan Antes, called meeting to order at 5:28 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith

Commissioners Absent: Shaknovich

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator, Joey King, Attendee, Jessica Schumer, Attendee,
Jesse Soria, Attendee, Antawnette Blade, Attendee.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Acting Chair Antes led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-51570  Recommendation to approve Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on November
  08, 2023.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Smith, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  5  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Blanco, Osorio Santiago, Shaknovich

2.  23-51571  Recommendation to receive and file presentation by Health Data Analytics Officer
  (per surveys conducted at 2023 Long Beach Veterans Celebration).

  Wilma Figueroa led a presentation on data collected via survey at the 2023 Long

  Page 1 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2023
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Beach Veterans Day Celebration. Nearly 40 (N=37) Veterans and their family
  members participated. A question and answer session followed.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Smith, seconded by Commissioner
  Doplemore, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Blanco, Osorio Santiago, Shaknovich

3.  23-51572  Recommendation to discuss 2023 Long Beach Veterans Celebration.

  The Commission was pleased with the success of the Veterans Day event, which
  was positively received by the public. Commissioners together with members of the
  public in attendance Antawnette Blade, Joey King, and Dr. Jessica
  Schumer commented on the success of the Veterans Day event, and offered
  suggestions such as a registration booth, and working closely with our partners
  (City Departments, Community-Based Organizations, Veteran-Serving
  Organizations and Veterans and their families to promote the event through their
  social media networks.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Contreras, to approve recommendation. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Blanco, Osorio Santiago, Shaknovich

PUBLIC COMMENT

No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

The Tibor Rubin VA Medical Center (VA Long Beach) and Veteran Social Committee hosts its Social
Mixer and Holiday Event on Friday, December 15, from 8:30 to 10:30 a.m. The People of the Earth
Krew will hold a Holiday Mixer at Ten Mile on Wednesday, December 20, from 6 to 8 p.m.

The Commission Coordinator noted that the Commission will need new members as the current ones

  Page 2 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2023
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

are termed out. Commissioners are asked to inform their respective Councilmembers of the
upcoming vacancies and to reach out to their contacts to inform them of same.Ad hoc subcommittee
members are also needed. (Such subcommittees comprise members of the Commission and
Veterans from the community). In the past year, the event planning (and fundraising) subcommittee
and a Veterans banner program committee were very active. These will continue. Other
subcommittees to be established or integrated into an existing one could include an alignment
committee focused on aligning the activities of the Office of Veterans Support align with the Veterans
Strategic plan or “small” events (as in not Veterans Day and Memorial Day) but smaller scale ones
like networking events (linking Veterans to employers). The Holiday Celebration has been moved to
the January 10 Veterans Commission Meeting. Commissioners were encouraged to invite their
partners, Councilmembers, Councilmembers’ Chiefs of Staff. Chair and VIce Chair elections will also
take place. The February meeting focuses on a review of the Brown Act.

ADJOURNMENT

Acting Chair Antes adjorned the meeting at 6:41.
